assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Game sprite asset sheet for Shovel Knight. Input image is identity/costume/reference only. short stocky blue armored knight, cyan metallic helmet with black T visor and two curved ivory horns, gold belt, blue gauntlets and boots, wooden shaft steel-blue shovel. Preserve short armored body and face-hidden helmet. Style: crisp professional pixel art matching reference, carefully placed hard square pixel clusters, dark stepped outlines, blue/cyan limited palette, NO blur or painterly antialiasing. Create a clean exact 4 columns by 4 rows grid (16 equal cells), 2048x2048 transparent PNG, no grid lines, no text, no scenery, no grey mannequins. One isolated COMPLETE full body per cell with a generous clear gap; feet/weapon/hair never cross a cell. Same body scale in every cell; body about 60% cell height, leave weapon room. Cell0 relaxed reference standing pose with feet level and character facing right-three-quarter; cell1 walking A;2 walking B;3 running A;4 run start;5 running B;6 braking;7 crouch;8 jump squat;9 rising jump;10 double jump;11 neutral airborne;12 falling;13 landing;14 turning;15 ready stance. Faithful face, head/body ratio and costume throughout. Weapons held but no detached VFX. Produce complete hand-drawn whole body poses, not a rig, not pieces.
